title: EQUITRIAGE: A FAIRNESS AUDIT OF GENDER BIAS IN LLM-BASED EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT TRIAGE

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual pair testing using clinical emergency department vignettes, swapping patient gender tokens and names (female ↔ male) while keeping all clinical content identical, and evaluating the flip rates and directional undertriage ratios (Female/Male) of the assigned Emergency Severity Index (ESI) scores.
